title: Longest Common Subsequence
summary: Length of the longest subsequence common to two strings.
approach: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1 if chars match, else max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]). Keep one row.
body: This is the core of diff algorithms; relates to how list diffing (e.g. `CollectionDifference`) computes inserts and removals.
